settings: Default Advanced Higher question types; no saved user customisation. Worksheet settings processed through the real worksheet filter.
limitations: Random sample, not exact long-run probabilities. Correct-answer patterns use canonical generator answers; accepted spelling synonyms are not separate answers. Score rendering and automatic marking were not tested. Each generator call had a 5-second timeout.
finding: AH makeQuestion uses makePracticePaperQuestion with level H and timeSignatureLevel AH, but makeEightBarRepetitionQuestion passes H as generationLevel. As a result keysForLevel(H), not keysForLevel(AH), supplies the actual key pool; AH key balancing is also bypassed.
